meta.title: Alumni Connect — turn shared history into shared opportunities
meta.description: A professional network for alumni: find mentors, advice, jobs and partners by school, expertise, company and location.

nav.footer: Alumni Connect · Turning shared history into shared opportunities

common.noResults: No alumni found. Try removing a filter.
common.notFoundText: We could not find what you were looking for.

home.heroTitle: Your past connections can build your future.
home.heroText: Find alumni by school, expertise, company or city. Ask for advice, find a mentor, share opportunities.
home.memberCount: {count, plural, one {# verified alumnus} other {# verified alumni}} so far
home.profileText: Share who you are, what you know and how you can help.
home.discoverText: Every school, company, skill and city is a link to everyone who shares it.
home.connectText: Verified alumni can unlock contacts and send connect requests.

directory.title: Alumni directory
directory.description: Browse alumni by school, faculty, company, job title, expertise and location.

tagPage.lead: Everyone in the network connected to “{name}”.
tagPage.description: {count, plural, one {# alumnus} other {# alumni}} linked to {name} ({kind}) on Alumni Connect.

login.title: Log in or sign up
login.lead: Enter your email and we will send you a one-time sign-in link. No password needed.
login.sent: Check your inbox. We sent you a sign-in link. Open it on this device.
login.error_email: Please enter a valid email address.
login.error_send: We could not send the email. Please try again.
login.error_link: That link is invalid or expired. Please request a new one.
login.note: After signing in you can get verified to unlock contact details and connect requests.

verify.title: Get verified
verify.lead: Tell us which school you attended. An administrator will review your claim. Verified members can see contact details and send connect requests.
verify.schoolHint: e.g. Hanoi University of Science and Technology
verify.evidenceHint: A LinkedIn profile, student card photo link or any page that shows your link to the school.
verify.noteHint: Anything that helps us verify you, e.g. class, supervisor, classmates.
verify.error: Please enter your school and try again.
verify.submitted: Thanks! Your claim was submitted and is waiting for review.
verify.pending: Your verification is waiting for review.
verify.rejected: We could not verify your last claim. You can submit it again with more details.
verify.invitePrompt: Have an invite link from another alumnus? Open it to be verified instantly.

profile.verifiedHint: Membership checked by an administrator or invited by a verified member
profile.selfPending: Your profile is waiting for verification. It becomes public after approval.
profile.selfUnverified: Your profile is not public yet. Get verified to appear in the directory.
profile.selfPrivate: Your profile is hidden from search engines and the directory.
profile.loginToUnlock: Log in as a verified alumnus to see contact details and send a connect request.
profile.verifyToUnlock: Verify your alumni membership to unlock contact details and connect requests.
profile.verifyPendingText: Your verification is pending. Contact details unlock after approval.
profile.introHint: Why would you like to connect?
profile.requestSent: Connect request sent. You can message each other once it is accepted.
profile.flashLimit: You have reached today's limit of connect requests.
profile.flashExists: You already have a connection or pending request with this person.
profile.flashError: Something went wrong. Please try again.
profile.flashReported: Thank you. An administrator will review your report.
profile.reportHint: What is wrong with this profile?

profileForm.expertiseAndHelp: Expertise and how you can help
profileForm.expertiseHint: Type a skill and press Enter
profileForm.contactHint: Only verified alumni can see these. Leave blank what you do not want to share.
